description: Validates each screen's mockup is standalone, portable, genuinely clickable, and free of external dependencies or framework leakage

checks.description: Mockup must exist for each screen in the inventory
checks.remediation: Run screen-generatemockup for every screen with a layout-spec.md

checks.description: Mockup must not reference any external stylesheet, script, or asset file
checks.remediation: Embed all CSS in a <style> block and all JS in a <script> block directly within mockup.html per R-626's portability requirement

checks.description: Generated mockup must not reference a specific application framework
checks.remediation: Per R-625, generate plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS only — no React, Vue, or Angular syntax/conventions

checks.description: Every navigation target must match the inventory and open the actual destination file; intentionally standalone screens need no artificial link
checks.confirmation_statement: I checked every cross-screen href and matching data-transition-target against the inventory and actual destination file, clicked each link and return path in the browser, and recorded results; any standalone screen has a documented rationale
checks.remediation: Perform actual link-resolution and click-through checks. A regex match is not a resolution test. Required missing links block completion

checks.description: Mockup portability (file:// open, zero setup) must be tested on a real browser, not merely assumed
checks.confirmation_statement: I opened each mockup via file:// and observed correct styling at 375 and 1440 px, no page-level overflow, no runtime errors or unexpected resource requests, and working navigation; results are recorded in Prototype Verification
checks.remediation: Test actual browser behavior and record evidence. If browser access is unavailable, leave the check Not run / blocked; launching a process, code inspection, or self-attestation alone is not a pass

checks.description: Enabled navigation cannot be a placeholder or a browser alert substitute for an application dialog
checks.remediation: Use real page links, designed native dialogs and working local handlers; show unresolved actions as visibly explained disabled controls

checks.description: Each screen must record actual expected and observed prototype checks
checks.remediation: Record contract checks with Expected, Observed, Status and Evidence; missing browser checks remain Not run / blocked

checks.description: Every specified control and dialog lifecycle must be exercised, including keyboard, validation and cancel semantics
checks.confirmation_statement: I exercised every Interaction Specification row in the browser, including dialog open, focus containment, Escape, cancel, reopen, invalid submit, valid save, focus restoration and backdrop policy where applicable, plus reachable empty/error/success states
checks.remediation: Execute and log the full interaction matrix. Do not pass merely because script tags, metadata or a dialog element exist
